DefensibilityClass.description:
Spec §5.6: `fact | utterance | non_factual`.

*fact*        — the unit asserts something the matrix permits as fact.
*utterance*   — someone said it; the system stands by the saying, not
                the substance.
*non_factual* — opinion / interpretation / rhetorical content.
DefensibilityClass.title: DefensibilityClass

QualificationRule.description:
One row of the matrix.

Per Spec §3.4: `(claim-genre × source-standing) → asserts_what`. The
`asserts_what` here is the *ceiling* the Solva governor will allow
when stamping the unit's Defensibility ring.

asserts_what.description: Ceiling: highest defensibility class permitted for this cell.

matrix_rule_id.description: Stable ID; quoted by units' DefensibilityRing.matrix_rule_ref.
matrix_rule_id.title: Matrix Rule Id

description:
The governed matrix.

Versioned by `matrix_rev` (e.g. "v0"). Frozen by snapshotting both
the schema (via Pydantic) and the *content* (the v0.json file).
Bumping the matrix requires re-blessing both snapshots.
title: QualificationMatrix
